title: Assistant Management Accountant
description:
Our client, an organisation based in Lincoln, are recruiting an Assistant Management Accountant initially on a 12 month contract, but this could turn into a permanent position. They do 2 days per week in the office, and 3 days from home.

Client Details

Our client is based in Lincoln and is an established and reputable organisation. They have great flexibility and opportunities to progress in future.

Description
- Assist in preparing monthly management accounts and financial reports.
- Posting journals, accruals and prepayments.
- Support the budgeting and forecasting processes.
- Help maintain accurate financial records and ledgers.
- Reconcile accounts as needed.
- Work closely with other departments to ensure financial accuracy.
- Assist in monitoring and controlling expenditure.
- Provide support for audits and ensure compliance with regulations.
- Contribute to process improvements within the finance team.

Profile

A successful Assistant Management Accountant should have:
- A background in accounting or finance.
- Experience with management accounts and financial reporting.
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Proficiency in using accounting software and Microsoft Excel.
- The ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
- A proactive approach to identifying and solving problems.

Job Offer
- Salary ranging from £35,000 to £40,000, dependent on the level of experience.
- Fixed-term contract based in Lincoln.
- Opportunities to gain valuable experience.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Assistant Accountant
description:
As an Assistant Accountant in the Not For Profit sector, based in Lincoln, you'll play a key role in overseeing financial processes, helping the organisation make sound financial decisions.

This is a hands-on role where you'll support the day-to-day financial operations and contribute to the smooth running of the finance department.

Client Details

This is a permanent opportunity in Lincoln to join a well established business as an Assistant Accountant.

Our client offers a hybrid model and the opportunity for study support within a varied role.

Description
- Prepare management accounts and financial reports for review.
- Assist in budgeting and forecasting processes to support strategic decision-making.
- Monitor and analyse financial performance, providing insights and recommendations.
- Ensure accurate and timely processing of financial data.
- Support the preparation of year-end accounts and audits.
- Maintain compliance with financial regulations and organisational policies.
- Collaborate with other departments to provide financial guidance.
- Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency.

Profile

A successful Assistant Accountant should have:
- Studying towards CIMA, ACCA or ACA.
- Candidates who have worked in similar positions but have not studied are advised to apply!
- Able to commute to our client's office in Lincolnshire.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Experience with preparing management accounts and financial reports.
- Knowledge of financial regulations and compliance requirements.
- Proficiency in accounting software and MS Excel.
- Attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.

Job Offer
- Salary ranging from £35,000 to £40,000, dependent on the level of experience.
- Benefits package to be confirmed.
- Permanent position based in Lincoln.
- Hybrid opportunity in Lincoln.

title: Payroll Clerk & Accounts Assistant
description:
Payroll Clerk & Accounts Assistant

Location: Caistor

Full Time

Monday to Friday 9:00am - 4:30pm

Manpower are currently recruiting for a Payroll Clerk & Accounts Assistant on behalf of our client. This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established business where you'll play a key role in supporting payroll, accounts and administration functions within a close-knit and friendly team.

If you're an organised and detail-focused individual with payroll experience and a background in accounts support, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

As a Payroll Clerk & Accounts Assistant, you'll be responsible for ensuring payroll is processed accurately and on time, whilst also providing support across the wider finance function.

Key Responsibilities
- Process weekly and monthly payroll accurately and within deadlines
- Maintain and update employee payroll records
- Check timesheets, holiday records, sickness absence and payroll data
- Respond to payroll-related queries from employees
- Process new starters and leavers
- Assist with pension administration and payroll submissions
- Prepare payroll reports and maintain payroll documentation
- Process employee expenses
- Process purchase and sales invoices
- Support accounts payable and accounts receivable activities
- Assist with general office administration duties
- Provide additional support to the finance team as required

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Previous payroll experience (essential)
- Experience within an accounts or bookkeeping environment
- Strong understanding of payroll processes and confidentiality requirements
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Office applications
- Experience using Sage Payroll and Sage Accounts (desirable)
- Ability to work independently and manage competing deadlines
- Strong communication and problem-solving skills
- A professional, positive and team-focused attitude

What's in it for You?
- Competitive salary of £27,000 - £34,000, dependent on experience
- Monday to Friday working hours, 9:00am - 4:30pm
- Paid 30-minute lunch break
- 22 days annual leave, plus an additional day off for your birthday
- Extra time off over Christmas while working within a skeleton staff rota
- Early finish at 12:30pm every other Friday
- Join a supportive team of just three people, where your contribution will be highly valued
- Laptop provided for office use
- Free onsite parking

Apply Today

If you're a dependable and trustworthy payroll professional looking for a varied role within a supportive and friendly team, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or contact the Manpower team for more information.

If you receive suspicious outreach claiming to be from us, please contact us via the ManpowerGroup website.

title: Bookkeeper - Practice
description:
Bookkeeper
Spalding (office based)
£26,000 - £31,000

A well-established accountancy practice in Spalding is seeking an experienced Bookkeeper to join its friendly and supportive team. This is a varied client-facing role offering genuine autonomy, with responsibility for managing your own workload and supporting a portfolio of clients across their bookkeeping and accounting needs. The role would suit an experienced practice bookkeeper looking to gain greater variety and responsibility.

Role Responsibilities
- Preparing bookkeeping records for a varied portfolio of clients.
- Preparing and submitting VAT returns.
- Completing bank and control account reconciliations.
- Reviewing client records and identifying queries or discrepancies.
- Preparing accounts to trial balance stage.
- Assisting with interim and management information.
- Liaising directly with clients to obtain information and resolve bookkeeping queries.
- Working with cloud accounting software, including Xero.
- Supporting the wider accounts and taxation team.
- Managing your own workload and ensuring deadlines are met.

Personal Requirements
- Good bookkeeping experience, ideally gained within an accountancy practice.
- Experience preparing VAT returns.
- Strong understanding of double-entry bookkeeping.
- Experience reconciling balance sheet accounts.
- Confidence communicating directly with clients.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage deadlines.
- Ability to work independently and take responsibility for your own work.
- Positive attitude and willingness to support colleagues.
- Experience preparing accounts to trial balance would be advantageous.
- AAT qualified, studying towards AAT, or qualified by experience.
- Experience with Xero would be particularly useful.
- Full, unrestricted right to work in the UK. Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Benefits
- 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Free on-site parking.
- Ongoing CPD and professional development.
- Genuine autonomy over your workload.
- Direct client contact.
- Annual team away day.
- Friendly and supportive working environment.

If you are an experienced Bookkeeper looking for a varied role within accountancy practice, with greater autonomy and direct client responsibility, apply today.

title: Demand Planner
description:
Demand Planner (12-18 Month FTC) - Scunthorpe/Hybrid - Competitive Salary

Elevation Recruitment Group is proud to be partnering exclusively with a leading manufacturing business in Scunthorpe that is looking to recruit a Demand Planner to support their business on a 12-18 month contract.

As the Demand Planner, you'll own the monthly S&OP cycle end to end and bring demand, supply and production together into a single plan that keeps customers happy and the operation running efficiently.

What's On Offer:
- Flexible hybrid working (3 days in the office / 2 days from home. You select which days best work for you
- 37.5 hours per week with an early 1pm finish every Friday (flexi time)
- Business performance and individual achievement-related bonuses
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Free on-site parking

Key Responsibilities:
- Coordinate and lead the monthly S&OP cycle, facilitating Demand Review, Supply Review, Pre-S&OP and Executive S&OP meetings
- Consolidate demand, supply, inventory and financial assumptions into one operating plan
- Develop and maintain rolling 3, 6, 12 and 24 month forecasts, working with Sales, Product Management and Projects to improve accuracy
- Translate forecasts into material, supply and capacity requirements, identifying gaps and recommending mitigation plans
- Build and maintain finite production schedules, releasing and prioritising work orders
- Run and review MRP outputs, managing lead times, safety stocks and reorder policies
- Maintain planning data integrity within the ERP system and support process and system improvements
- Support new product introduction, product transitions and end-of-life planning

Previous Experience:
- A background in demand planning or supply chain planning
- Strong understanding of S&OP or Integrated Business Planning principles
- Hands-on ERP/MRP experience (IFS would be a real advantage)
- Advanced Excel skills
- Confident communicator

About Elevation Recruitment Group
Elevation Recruitment Group is a specialist recruitment consultancy operating across Procurement & Supply Chain, HR, Finance and Business Change. We work in partnership with businesses across Yorkshire, the East Midlands and beyond to connect exceptional talent with genuinely exciting opportunities.

title: Apprentice Clerical Assistant
description: Open to young people aged 16-21, with extended eligibility for care leavers, prison leavers, and those with an Education, Health, and Care (EHC) Plan up to age 24. The NEL Community Therapy provides Occupational Therapy and Physiotherapy to support people with health and social care needs to stay in their own home and help them remain independent. Community Therapy staff are employed by both Care Plus Group and Northern Lincolnshire and Goole NHS Foundation Trust working in partnership and provide direct clinical interventions through assessment of need and person centered goal planning. The range of interventions includes treatment, rehabilitation, minor and major housing adaptations, loan of equipment and moving and handling solutions for children and adults with a primary physical disability. Please note that Care Plus Group are not currently registered to sponsor applicants from outside the EU and EEA. Apprentice Clerical Assistant Community Therapy Team Based: Cromwell Road Primary Care Centre 30 hours per week - Mon - Fri National Minimum Wage dependent on age. Apprenticeship course - Level 2 Administration Assistant This apprenticeship standard is open to: Young people aged 16-21 . Young people aged 22-24 who are care leavers, have an EHCP, or are prison leavers. Duration - 12 months Qualifications - Level 2 qualification in English and Maths is required (GCSE grade 4+/C+ or functional skills). The post holder will work with supervision close by and within established procedures and will: Provide administrative support to the manager and clinical staff in providing Occupational and Physiotherapy Therapy assessment and intervention to physically disabled residents living in North East Lincolnshire thereby helping to maintain people's independence and improved health and wellbeing. Undertake routine clerical duties, e.g. photocopying, scanning, computer work, message taking, telephone enquiries. If you would like more details or an informal chat about the post, please contact Helen Lucas on 03033 306921 The job description is attached as a separate document with the person spec - please refer to it for more information. We appreciate how useful AI can be in todays workplace. For this application though, we want to understand your own thoughts and experience. We will be checking applications for AI usage, and those that appear to be significantly AI-generated may be subject to additional scrutiny.

title: Receptionist
description: The GP receptionist is responsible for undertaking a wide range of reception duties and providing support to the multidisciplinary team. Duties may include, but are not limited to, greeting and directing patients, effective use of the appointment system, booking appointments, processing of personal information and assisting patients as required. To act as a central point of contact for patients, the distribution of information, messages and enquiries for the clinical team, liaising with the multidisciplinary team member and external agencies such as secondary care and community service providers. The core responsibilities of the receptionist are as follows. On occasion, there may be a requirement to carry out tasks not listed below, that are within the reasonable scope of the role. Maintain and monitor practice appointment system Process personal, telephone and e-requests for appointments Answer incoming phone calls, dealing with the callers request appropriately Signpost patients to the correct service Initiating contact with and responding to, requests from patients, team members and external agencies Data entry of new and temporary registrations and relevant patient information as requested Input data as necessary onto patients healthcare records Direct requests for information to relevant team members i.e., SAR, DVLA forms, insurance/solicitors letters Manage all queries as necessary in an efficient manner Carry out system searches as requested Support all clinical staff with general tasks as required Photocopy documentation as required Maintain a clean, tidy and effective working area Monitor and maintain the reception area and notice boards In addition to the core responsibilities, the Receptionist may be requested to; 1. Action incoming emails and correspondence as necessary 2. Complete opening and closing procedures in accordance with the rota 3. Partake in audit as directed by the audit lead 4. Support admin team, providing cover during absences 5. Scan patient related documents and attach scanned documents to patients healthcare record We currently have 2 part time vacancies available allowing us to be flexible for the right candidate. All hours will be worked between 08:00 and 18:30, Monday to Friday

title: Pharmacy Administrator
company: Navigo Health and Social Care CIC
advertiser_name: Navigo Health and Social Care CIC
description: 15 hours per week - Wednesday - Friday (hours to be agreed) An exciting opportunity has arisen for an organised and motivated Pharmacy Administrator to join our Pharmacy Team. In this role, you will play a key part in providing efficient administrative support and helping the team deliver high-quality services. We are looking for someone with excellent organisational skills, a keen eye for detail, and a positive, adaptable approach. If you enjoy working as part of a supportive team and are committed to delivering excellent administrative support, we would be delighted to hear from you. The Pharmacy Administrator will provide an efficient, accurate and confidential administrative service to the Lead Clinical Pharmacist and Pharmacy Team. The post holder will support the smooth running of pharmacy admin. Receive, record, process and distribute routine and non-routine information relating to pharmacy administration, including documents containing clinical and pharmaceutical terminology. Provide administrative support to the Lead Clinical Pharmacist and Pharmacy Team, including diary support, meeting co-ordination, minute taking at meetings, document preparation, audit support and maintenance of electronic records. Support the administration of pharmacy governance meetings, committees and medication-related policy processes under the direction of the Lead Clinical Pharmacist. Maintain accurate systems for pharmacy records, including prescription pad allocation, stock monitoring, distribution lists, action logs and relevant databases or spreadsheets. Act as a first point of administrative contact for internal and external pharmacy-related enquiries, resolving routine matters where appropriate and escalating queries outside agreed procedures. COMMUNICATION Monitor designated pharmacy email inboxes each working day, responding to routine enquiries within agreed administrative procedures and escalating clinical, medicines-related or governance queries to the Lead Clinical Pharmacist or Pharmacy Team. Communicate clearly and professionally with service users, carers, clinicians, managers, community services, external agencies and other stakeholders, ensuring messages are accurate, timely and appropriately recorded. Handle confidential and sensitive information in line with organisational policies, data protection requirements and information governance standards. Maintain regular communication with the Lead Clinical Pharmacist, including at least weekly contact to review current administrative priorities, outstanding actions, risks, issues and deadlines. Draft routine correspondence, responses and standard documents on behalf of the Pharmacy Team, seeking approval where required before circulation. PLANNING AND ORGANISATION Arrange pharmacy meetings, committees and forums, including room or online meeting set-up, calendar invites, agendas, papers, attendance records and distribution of documentation. Take accurate notes or minutes at pharmacy meetings, record decisions and actions, maintain action logs and follow up outstanding actions with the chair or action owner. Maintain circulation lists, distribution groups and contact lists for pharmacy meetings, forums and relevant communications. Prioritise own workload to meet agreed deadlines, seeking guidance where demands conflict or where issues require escalation. Support administrative preparation for audits, policy reviews, governance reports and other pharmacy-related workstreams as directed. GENERAL ADMINISTRATIVE DUTIES Maintain accurate electronic and paper records relating to pharmacy administration, ensuring information is filed, updated and retrievable in accordance with local procedures. Maintain databases and spreadsheets used by the Pharmacy Team, inputting and checking data accurately and escalating discrepancies or missing information. Produce, format and distribute correspondence, reports, presentations, meeting packs, action logs and other documents using Microsoft Office and relevant organisational systems. Support document control processes for medication-related policies, standard operating procedures and governance papers, including version control, circulation and approved storage locations. Ensure data entered or recorded by the post holder is relevant, accurate, complete and captured in a timely manner. Maintain accurate records of prescription pad allocation, receipt, issue and stock levels in accordance with organisational procedures. Arrange replenishment of prescription pad stock when required, escalating low stock, discrepancies, losses or governance concerns promptly to the Lead Clinical Pharmacist and Pharmacy Team. Support routine checks of pharmacy administrative stock and documentation, ensuring records are available for audit or governance review when requested. WORKFORCE Have input into training new team members on internal processes and procedures. PERSONAL RESPONSIBILITIES Complete and maintain mandatory training in line with organisational requirements, aiming to maintain personal compliance at or above the required organisational standard. Take responsibility for the quality, accuracy and timeliness of own work, seeking guidance where required. Work in accordance with Navigo values, code of conduct, policies, procedures and standards of professional behaviour. Maintain confidentiality at all times and comply with requirements relating to information governance, data protection, access to health records and records management. Comply with health and safety, fire safety, infection prevention and control, safeguarding, equality and diversity, business continuity, Mental Capacity Act and Deprivation of Liberty requirements relevant to the role. Participate in supervision, appraisal, personal development review and relevant training to support performance in the role.
